ML-015: Barbados: J. W. Orderson, Creoleana. Author from the slave-owning planter elite; the narrative is set within slavery.
ML-146: Saint Kitts and Nevis: James Grainger. Plantation physician in a slave-owning family; author of The Sugar-Cane.
ML-168: Suriname: John Gabriel Stedman. Soldier sent to suppress the maroon revolt; the Joanna episodes describe an attachment within slavery.
ML-110: Mauritius: Bernardin de Saint-Pierre, Paul et Virginie. French colonial author; the story is set in a plantation slave society.
